caption: A returning sailor kisses his wife, who is holding their baby.
Santiago, Chile A man walks on a mud-covered street after heavy rains triggered a mudslide.
Santiago, Chile Carabineros inspect a vehicle swept away by a mudslide in the Las Condes district of the city.
Lucknow, India A kite flies over rescue boats moored next to a police building as water from the overflowing Gomti River floods the residential area of Faizullaganj.
San Diego, US The US navy Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln arrives home after an extended deployment in the Middle East.
New York City, US A protester faces off with New York police officers during a protest at a crime scene after an ICE officer allegedly shot a man in New York.
Soweto, South Africa A looter removes goods from a convenience store after clashes between anti-immigration protesters and some foreign nationals.

Durban, South Africa Police help people to take cover after clashes between protesters and foreign nationals. Tensions over migration were reignited by a court order saying the government must restart the processing of asylum applications.
Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine A person enters an apartment building damaged in a Russian airstrike.
Gaza City, Gaza Palestinians inspect the destruction caused by an Israeli airstrike that hit a residential building in the Sabra area of the city.

Brussels, Belgium Electronic scooters and bikes burn, as people, including students, attend a demonstration during a nationwide strike against the Belgian government’s austerity measures and budget cuts.
Washington DC, US Demonstrators hold signs during a Stop Sexual Violence protest at the Washington Monument as part of rallies being held following the Cornell University rape allegations.
London, UK A scene from End of the World and Hard-Boiled Wonderland by Haruki Murakami and Philippe Decouflé at the Barbican theatre.
New York City, US Cosplayers take photographs during the opening day of New York Comic-Con at the Jacob Javits Center in Manhattan.

Pacific Ocean The SpaceX Crew Dragon Freedom spacecraft splashes down off the coast of Los Angeles with Nasa astronauts Jessica Meir and Jack Hathaway, the ESA astronaut Sophie Adenot, and Roscosmos cosmonaut Andrey Fedyaev.
People watch the projection show on Loch Dunmore at The Enchanted Forest in Pitlochry.
Berlin, Germany The German chancellor, Friedrich Merz, and the UK prime minister, Andy Burnham, observe the honour guard (unpictured) upon Burnham’s arrival for talks at the chancellery.

Mbour, Senegal Fishers head out to sea at dawn despite heavy rains and stormy weather in the Petite Côte region. Using traditional wooden pirogues, they bring their daily catch back to be sold at local markets and play a key role in the nation’s seafood trade and processing industry.

Paris, France Adult protesters form a human chain to protect teenagers during a blockade near Hélène Boucher high school, part of a nationwide movement over learning conditions. Since late September, pupils have barred the entrances to hundreds of schools, complaining of teacher absences, overloaded timetables, dilapidated classrooms and buildings ill-adapted to rising temperatures.
Ripon, UK A stag at Studley Royal Park in North Yorkshire.
Asuncion, Paraguay Mika Moritoki from Japan competes in the women’s senior classic freestyle slalom event at the 2026 World Skating Games.

San Diego, US Milwaukee Brewers players celebrate after the team defeated the San Diego Padres in Game 4 of baseball’s National League Division Series in California, advancing to the National League Championship Series.

Semporna, Malaysia Newborn green turtles crawl towards the sea after being released from a wildlife protection area on Mataking Island. The palm-size hatchlings flailing their flippers through the sand are a symbol of hope – green turtles have made the rare jump from endangered to ‘least concern’, a remarkable conservation success.

Taiz, Yemen A fighter affiliated with the Houthis fires his machine gun as they advance against Saudi-backed Yemeni government troops. Saudi officials said on Wednesday that three people had been killed in attacks on two of the kingdom’s international airports, including in the capital, Riyadh, after Yemen’s Houthis claimed to have fired on both transport hubs.

Pitlochry, Scotland Onlookers gather to watch a projection show on Loch Dunmore at the Enchanted Forest. This year’s sound and light spectacular celebrates its 25th year with Stop the Clock: the 25th Hour.
Kyiv, Ukraine Rescuers outside a damaged five-storey residential building after a Russian drone attack.

London, UK A painting by Piet Mondrian called Composition III (Komposition No XIII) is displayed at Christie’s auction rooms. It is estimated at £20-30m ($26-40m) and will form part of the 20th/21st Century: London Evening Sale.
Zaporizhzhia region, Ukraine A Ukrainian serviceman prepares to launch middle-range Darts drones.
credit: Andriy Andriyenko/Press service of the 65th Separate Mechanised Brigade/AFP/Getty

caption: San Antonio, US Supporters cheer as the US president, Donald Trump, arrives to speak at a rally at the Freeman Coliseum in Texas. The Republican Ken Paxton is in a close race with the Democrat James Talarico for one of the Texas Senate seats.
Huzhou, China Tourists take photos in the blooming pink grass at Sanhewan park in Zhejiang province. The blooming flowers have attracted many citizens and tourists.
Istanbul, Turkey Search and rescue teams evacuate an injured person on a stretcher after the lower floors of a seven-storey building partly collapsed in the Maltepe district.
Rome, Italy Members of parliament protest in Italy’s lower house of parliament on the day of a final vote on a contested electoral reform proposed by the prime minister, Giorgia Meloni.

Havana, Cuba Theatregoers walk past torches that illuminate the entrance and form part of the set for a performance staged without electricity by the Impulso Teatro theatre group. Daily blackouts are posing severe challenges for the performing arts.
Aerial view of a Tel Aviv beach memorial, with rows of people beside Hebrew text in the sand.
New Delhi, India The opposition leader Rahul Gandhi attends a protest demanding the resignation of India’s chief election commissioner, Gyanesh Kumar.
Marseille, France High school students march through the streets to protest against budget cuts affecting the education system.
Paris, France Students stage a sit-in to block the street outside the Sciences Po university as part of the nationwide student protests demanding better school conditions.

Gloucestershire, UK Cattle are judged at the Dairy Show at the Bath and West showground, Shepton Mallet. The event is one of the most important dates in the dairy farmers’ calendar, combining a trade show with an exhibition of top-quality cattle.
West Midlands, UK The Conservative party leader, Kemi Badenoch, with her husband, Hamish Badenoch, leaves the stage after delivering her keynote speech during the party conference in Birmingham.
London, UK Pedestrians cross Westminster Bridge during a rain shower.
Tel Aviv, Israel People carrying Israeli national flags walk on the beachfront through an installation marking the third anniversary of the Hamas attack on Israel.
Kibbutz Re’im, Israel Raz Zarfati, the sister of Ron Zarfati, killed in the 7 October 2023 Hamas attack, attends a memorial at the Nova music festival site marking the anniversary.
Strasbourg, France Members of the European parliament applaud during a plenary session for the former Israeli hostage Omri Miran, who was held by Hamas in captivity for 738 days.

Gaza City A girl looks at the temporary tents of displaced Palestinians among destroyed buildings. Israel carried out new strikes in Gaza as it marked the anniversary of the attacks by Hamas , with Palestinian officials reporting two dead.
Pryluky, Ukraine Local people and rescuers clear the rubble of a residential building destroyed in a Russian missile strike.

Sana’a, Yemen Houthi fighters shout slogans while holding up weapons during a campaign to mobilise more fighters. As fighting between the Houthis and the Saudi-led coalition escalates, the head of Yemen’s internationally recognised government, Rashad al-Alimi, announced on 4 October the launch of military operations to retake remaining territory held by the Houthis.
Nairobi, Kenya A nurse wears a protective suit at the hospital where an Ebola patient was isolated immediately upon arrival and treated at an isolation facility, but later died.

Bangkok, Thailand A rainstorm over south-western Bangkok. The Thai capital has experienced its worst flooding in 15 years after up to 300mm of rain in late September. Many areas of Bangkok and other provinces such as Samut Prakan were flooded and have remained inundated for over a week, with at least 40 deaths across the country.
Milan, Italy People attend the Matisse exhibition at Mudec, the Museo delle Culture.
Madrid, Spain Mario Vaquerizo, centre, performs at the press preview of the musical Cabaret at the Espacio Delicias.
